title: UI/UX - Design for Restructured Financial Overview Layout and Pagination for Transaction Summary and Payments Tables

walkthroughSteps.title: Transaction summary
walkthroughSteps.body: Transaction summary is the first panel and is open on load, so it is visible without scrolling. Every other table below it sits in a collapsed panel.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: No interaction here: this step points at the section itself. Pagination is not built yet: the table shows a plain item count.

walkthroughSteps.title: Financial details
walkthroughSteps.body: Collapsed by default, as the Jira story asks. Click the header to open it.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Financial Overview opens with the Transaction Summary at the top and the other panels collapsed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Financial Overview's **Transaction Summary** is the first panel, open on page load, so it is visible without scrolling. **Financial details** below it is collapsed by default and opens on click. The summary tiles stay above both. **NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** the ticket calls for pagination on this table; the current build shows a plain count instead, no page controls. **NOTE:** Payments, Reserves and Recovery bookings are separate views in the Financial menu, not panels on this page.

setup.description: Uses CLM-2024-001's existing financial data: no override needed

preconditions.text: Transaction Summary panel open at the top

expectedUI.description: Transaction Summary open at the top, Financial details collapsed
visualCues: Transaction summary panel open, with item count
Financial details panel collapsed below it

howToTest.trigger: Load the page, then click Financial details
howToTest.expectedResult: Transaction summary is visible on load; Financial details opens on click
